subject.title: node:sqlite missing FTS5 module — memory search keyword fallback broken

question: Should OpenClaw restore keyword recall on runtimes where `node:sqlite` is present but FTS5 is unavailable, and which strategy should own that behavior?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but the acceptable fix shape affects dependency strategy, degraded search semantics, and user-visible memory recall behavior; automation should not choose that product boundary while the issue is assigned and related PRs are open.

options.title: Restore degraded keyword recall
options.body: Land or request a bounded fallback/backend strategy that returns exact-token memory results when FTS5 cannot initialize, with clear degraded-mode metadata and upgrade proof.

options.title: Diagnostic-only degradation
options.body: Accept vector-only or empty keyword behavior on FTS5-unavailable runtimes, but make doctor/status/docs clearly explain the limitation and remediation path.

options.title: Backend swap discussion
options.body: Use this issue to sponsor a broader SQLite binding or packaged-runtime decision, with platform proof before changing dependencies.

recommendation.title: Restore degraded keyword recall
recommendation.body: Land or request a bounded fallback/backend strategy that returns exact-token memory results when FTS5 cannot initialize, with clear degraded-mode metadata and upgrade proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue is currently assigned to osolmaz, so they are the best available owner for the product-direction choice.
